label: r02-C2-T3-1
critiques: trialPrompt lists only prompt.md, tools.json and the ticket file in allowedPaths. It says "Never touch: ${FORBIDDEN.join(', ')}", and FORBIDDEN includes spe/evals/graders/ (which holds grade.py and judge.md), spe/evals/tasks/answers.json and spe/predictions/. A self-report check and a transcript audit void any trial that reads those paths.

The script has a `dryRun` arg with `dryCells`, and baseWaves runs only those cells with n: 1. Gate four in the paragraph runs the dry run on B/T001, C2/T001 and C2/T002 before the full launch, with explicit pass conditions.

Gate two runs `grade.py --selftest` with an oracle check (50/50), an empty check (0/50) and a swapped-values check (0/50). Gate three regrades round 3's saved outputs with today's grade.py and requires an exact match to the r03 Measured column in spe/prediction-log.md.

`CAP_USD = 40` is fixed in the script. reserveTrial runs before each trial agent and checks `next > CAP_USD - COST.tail`. When that check fails, it pushes the trial to `skips` and calls log(`SKIP ...`). It reserves grading, audit and judge cost up front, so a trial that runs can also be graded and judged.

gradeWave runs first and has a helper agent run grade.py against answers.json for category and priority. The helper is told "You do not grade anything yourself." The Opus judge is told to "Judge tone only. Do not judge whether the category or priority is right." Empty replies are caught by a code check before the judge sees them.

The script picks split cells with `base_pass > 0 && base_pass < base_valid` and sorts them so cells closest to 50% come first. Each split cell gets up to `EXTRA_PER_CELL` (5) extra trials, and all extras together are limited by `EXTRA_CAP` (60). The script logs when that cap is reached.

The script ends with a 'Failure analysis' agent and a 'Completeness critic' agent. The round is held in one constant, `const ROUND = 4`. The `RR` value is derived from it and is used in trial ids, labels and the critic's prediction and plan paths.
